flags.no_half_word_in_title: a composite key whose event title has no half-marathon word (half, halb, halv, semi, demi, medio, media, mezza, meia, mitja, mitad, 21)
flags.platform_prefix: the part before ": " is a timing platform’s name, so the key states no place

rules.codes: tier, split-tier and timing codes are the lists of lib/tiers.ts when the files were built; scripts/verify-half.cjs compares every code, class and word with the module itself
rules.copy: an edition the half policy sets aside as a copy of another edition is listed with no number and is not shown
rules.listed: every half-marathon edition of the release with rows, of either source database; an excluded edition has no rows and never appears
rules.median: the median finish of a verified usable edition of at least 100 results that carries no mark; no other edition has a time
rules.never: no runner name, bib, winner, source URL, producer status or reason text, or official count
rules.order: races by name (accents and case aside), then place, then label; a race’s editions by year, then source database
rules.race: the races, their labels, names and places are the frozen half race registry’s (analysis/half-race-registry.json, rebuilt from the tier table and compared before every build): a release key joins a race only by a reviewed join; a key with no entry is its own race, named from the key alone; half and marathon are separate name spaces
rules.results: an edition’s results are its rows after the record rules R1 to R8 of the half policy; for the half editions of the marathon database, the rows with a readable finish that the frozen half row rule keeps
rules.use: verified: a verified usable edition (it supplies the verified figures); usable: an unverified usable edition (it supplies only figures that carry the scope chip); none: it supplies no figure
